mentions.name: FFmpeg Commander
mentions.description: A web-based FFmpeg command builder that generates common ffmpeg commands. Originally built around 7 years ago in Vue2 and Bootstrap as a simple static frontend tool, it was recently refreshed as version 2.0, ported to a Vite/React/Tailwind static frontend.
